title: Brand Terms
intro: These Brand Terms apply to companies that use Spektt as a brand ("Brand", "you"), on top of Spektt's general Terms and Conditions (spektt.com/terms) and Privacy Policy (spektt.com/privacy). Spektt is operated by Axlume Tech Limited ("Spektt", "we", "us"), registered with the Corporate Affairs Commission of the Federal Republic of Nigeria.
If these Brand Terms and the general Terms disagree on something about brand accounts or brand Showdowns, these Brand Terms apply.

sections.heading: 1. Who May Open a Brand Account
items: A brand account belongs to a company, organisation or business, not a person. It is opened by someone 18 or over who is authorised to act for that brand; by accepting these terms they accept them on the brand's behalf and confirm that authority.
A brand needs its own account. An existing creator account cannot become a brand account.

You must give accurate details: the brand's name, industry, website (the brand's own, starting https://), a work email at that website's domain (not Gmail, Yahoo, Outlook or another free email service) and the applicant's full name.
You must have the right to use the brand's name and logo. Pretending to be a brand you do not represent is impersonation: the account is removed and may be reported.

sections.heading: 2. Verification
items: We email a 6-digit code to your work email. Confirming it proves you can receive mail at the brand's domain.

We also check whether the brand name is close to a well-known brand and when the website's domain was registered. If the name is close to a well-known brand, or the domain is under 6 months old or its age cannot be confirmed, a person at Spektt reviews the application, usually within 2 business days. Otherwise the brand is verified as soon as the email is confirmed.

A verified brand shows a gold badge beside its name everywhere on Spektt. The badge means Spektt confirmed control of the brand's email domain; it is not an endorsement of the brand, its products or its claims.

If we reject an application we tell you why. You may fix it and apply again from the app (three applications per account in all), or appeal a rejection within 3 business days by email to safety@spektt.com.

Your website and work email are fixed once verified. Moving to a new domain is a new verification (contact support@spektt.com). A new brand name is checked again; a name close to a different well-known brand is refused.

sections.heading: 3. What a Brand Account Can and Cannot Do
paras: A verified brand can keep a public brand page (logo, name, industry, About, website), post work such as briefs and campaign material, follow creators, and present Showdowns (section 5).

A brand account cannot enter or vote in Showdowns; create or join Clusters; earn XP, badges or a leaderboard place; buy Spektt Pro; or start an ordinary direct message. Its only way to contact a creator is an inquiry (below). Until verified, a brand's page is visible only to the brand, and it cannot post, follow or appear in search.

A verified brand's private Console lets it save creators, posts and Showdowns (only the brand sees them; nobody is told) and see a report for each Showdown it presents: entries, views, votes after results, and how many entrants come from each city, never who.

sections.heading: Inquiries to Creators
paras: A verified brand may send an inquiry, a first message about work, to a creator who has switched on Open to work and is 18 or over. The creator sees it as a request and may accept it (it becomes a normal chat), decline, block or report.
items: Limits. At most 5 new inquiries a day. After a creator declines, you cannot send them another for 30 days.

Never ask a creator to pay. No registration, application, casting, training or "starter kit" fees, deposits, or anything else a creator must pay to get or keep work. It is a serious breach and may lead to the account's removal (section 9).

Be who you say you are. Describe real work, from your brand, at the rate you state. No impersonation, no recruiting for another company without saying so, and no moving a creator off Spektt to deceive them.

Review. Blocks and reports against a brand are reviewed by a person, never acted on automatically. Spektt may pause a brand's inquiries while it looks into them, and tells the brand; existing chats and the brand page are not affected by a pause.
Spektt is not a party to any work agreed through an inquiry. Rates, rights, delivery and payment are between the brand and the creator.

sections.heading: 4. Your Page and Content
items: Everything on your page and in your posts must be accurate, lawful and follow the Community Guidelines. You are responsible for any advertising claims you make, including any rules that apply to advertising in your country.
You keep ownership of your logo and content. You let Spektt display them on Spektt and in Spektt's own promotion of your page or your Showdowns, for as long as your account exists.
You must not ask creators to pay you, to move a Showdown conversation off Spektt, or to trade votes; nor contact entrants about a Showdown outside Spektt while it is running.

sections.heading: 5. Brand Showdowns
items: A verified brand can propose a Showdown: its name, brief, rules, judging criteria, dates and a cash prize pool split into first, second and third prizes. Prizes are cash only: no products, vouchers or services.

Spektt is the Sponsor of every Showdown under its Official Showdown Rules (spektt.com/showdown-rules); the brand appears as its "Presented by" partner, with its name and logo linking to its page. Apple and Google are not sponsors and are not involved.
Brand Showdowns are Premium Showdowns, open to adults in Nigeria for now. Submissions stay open for at least 7 days and open at least 3 days after the Showdown is submitted.

Pool limits: at least ₦100,000 (₦50,000 in a Cluster); up to ₦500,000 for a brand's first Showdown, and up to ₦1,000,000 after one completed Showdown. One brand Showdown at a time; a Showdown is finished once its winners are announced.

Spektt's judges (three to seven, chosen by Spektt) judge by the published criteria; the brand does not choose the judges or the winners. Votes count only from trusted accounts. Results follow the Official Showdown Rules.
Once it is paid for, Spektt reviews the Showdown within 1 business day and publishes it, or rejects it with a reason (section 8). Once paid for, its prizes cannot be changed.
Entrants keep ownership of their work. Presenting a Showdown gives the brand no rights in any entry; any use of an entry must be agreed directly with its creator.

In a Cluster: a Cluster's admin may invite you to present a Showdown there, with a drafted brief, but only if you switch invites on (Console, Sponsorship invites; optionally for some categories and a minimum Cluster size). You may change anything before paying, decline (that Cluster cannot invite you again for 30 days) or block the Cluster. Only members who joined before submissions opened may enter or vote, and the Cluster's admin and moderators may not enter. The admin receives nothing: no fee, share or credit, and offering one is a breach of these terms.

sections.heading: 6. Fees and Payment
items: You pay the prize pool plus Spektt's fee of 25% of the pool, charged on top: a ₦200,000 pool costs ₦250,000. The whole pool goes to the winners (less the withholding tax described in the Official Showdown Rules); the fee is Spektt's.

Your brand account. Once verified, your brand gets its own bank account number, held for Spektt by our payment processor (named in the Privacy Policy). You pay by bank transfer to that account, in one or several transfers. Spektt never takes payment inside the app.

Every transfer becomes credit for your brand. When you submit a Showdown, its pool and fee are paid from your credit; until your credit covers it, the Showdown waits. Spektt records transfers within 1 business day of receiving them, and a large transfer may need a second check by Spektt staff first. Spektt pays the processor's transfer fees; you are credited what you sent.
"Paid to creators" on your page is what your Showdowns have paid winners (net of tax withheld), calculated from actual payouts. It cannot be edited.

sections.heading: 7. Prizes Nobody Claims
paras: A winner has 14 days to claim; an unclaimed prize passes to the next eligible entrant, at most twice. A prize nobody ends up with goes back to you as credit and is never kept by Spektt. Credit can be used on future Showdowns, or refunded on request.

sections.heading: 8. Cancellations and Refunds
items: Too few entries (Premium Showdowns need 10): submissions are extended once, by 7 days. If there are still too few, the Showdown closes: the pool goes back to your credit, and the fee is carried to your next Showdown (it pays that Showdown's fee only and cannot be withdrawn).
You withdraw before Spektt approves the Showdown: everything you paid goes back to your credit.
Spektt rejects or cancels the Showdown: everything goes back to your credit, refundable on request.
Once enough creators have entered, the brand cannot cancel the Showdown: creators have done the work.

sections.heading: 9. Suspension and Removal
paras: We may warn a brand, pause its inquiries, or suspend or remove its account, page or a Showdown for breaking these Brand Terms, the general Terms, the Community Guidelines or the law, or for suspected impersonation or fraud. A suspension is always a person's decision, never automatic.
A suspended brand's running Showdown continues for its entrants, no longer linking to the brand, and its credit is frozen until we review it.

sections.heading: 10. General
paras: Liability, indemnity, governing law and disputes are as in the general Terms (the laws of the Federal Republic of Nigeria). We may update these Brand Terms; we email material changes to your work email before they take effect.
Contact: support@spektt.com · Appeals: safety@spektt.com · Axlume Tech Limited, Federal Republic of Nigeria.
